column1: # propagation-manifest.tsv
# Mirror-governed file list with pinned SHA-256 hashes for portfolio-base-template.
# Authored 2026-08-02 per Ruben's A1-1 ruling; hashes recomputed at authoring time
# directly from the live repo and cross-checked against the Baseline Pin Table
# (6_control/repo-audit-5-portfolio-base-template-2026-07-12.md, 2026-07-12).
# Columns:
#   path              - repo-relative path of the mirror-governed file
#   role              - MIRROR (propagate verbatim to targets) or ADAPT (targets
#                       customize this file per-target; only the template's own
#                       baseline pin is tracked here)
#   sha256_live       - SHA-256 recomputed from the live file at authoring time
#   sha256_pin_table  - SHA-256 recorded in the Baseline Pin Table (2026-07-12)
#   status            - PINNED (live matches pin table) or DRIFT (live differs;
#                       both hashes listed, neither silently adopted)
# Any file changed in the template MUST have its sha256_live (and status, if it
# changes) bumped in this manifest in the SAME change that alters the file.
# See docs/propagation.md for the full procedure.
# NOTE (pin-table hash truncation): the Baseline Pin Table records only the
# first 16 hex characters of each SHA-256 (its "..." suffix below reflects
# that — the table itself never carried a full 64-char value). All 19
# recomputed live hashes matched the pin table's recorded 16-char prefix
# exactly at authoring time (18 of 19 rows: status PINNED, zero DRIFT). The
# CLAUDE.md row is UPDATED-THIS-PASS: this same A1-1 authoring pass added one
# §10 Documentation Index line (web-ui-coverage-matrix.md, A2-3 micro-fix) to
# CLAUDE.md itself, so its live hash now reflects that edit rather than the
# 2026-07-12 pin-table baseline. New live hash recomputed post-edit and
# recorded below; this is an intentional, in-pass bump per docs/propagation.md
# step 1 (file change and manifest pin bump in the same change), not drift.
# NOTE (role assignment — authoring inference, labeled as such): neither the
# plan nor the pin table assigns MIRROR/ADAPT per file. Roles below follow
# the plan's stated semantics (MIRROR = propagate verbatim; ADAPT = target
# customizes): governance/tooling files common across all targets (CLAUDE.md,
# validate-structure.sh, bootstrap.sh, template-tokens.tsv, the six skills,
# qa-plan.md, web-ui-coverage-matrix.md, ci.yml) are marked MIRROR; narrative
# per-project documents that are expected to diverge per target (hooks.md,
# architecture.md, implementation-plan.md, ADR-001-template.md, QA.md,
# operations.md) are marked ADAPT. Ruben should confirm/correct this
# classification before any target sync dispatches against it.
# MIRROR/ADAPT roles CONFIRMED as written (Ruben, 2026-08-02; reviewed manifest clean).
# NOTE (2026-08-02, ruling 7 — root-fix pass): CLAUDE.md and .claude/hooks/hooks.md
# were edited to reword their settings.json references (no .claude/settings.json
# exists in this template; only .claude/settings.local.json is present). Both rows'
# sha256_live recomputed post-edit and marked UPDATED-THIS-PASS per docs/propagation.md
# step 1. README.md was also edited in the same pass but carries no manifest row (not
# a mirror-governed file) so no row update applies to it.
